name: Grand Hyatt Vail
positioning: Ski-in/ski-out mountain resort (officially Grand Hyatt Vail Resort and Spa) at the base of Vail Mountain alongside Gore Creek
best_for: Skiers who want lift access from Chair 20 steps from the door
Families wanting bunk-bed rooms, an arcade and a movie theater
Groups wanting a residence of up to nine bedrooms with resort amenities

facts.text: The resort sits at the base of Vail Mountain alongside Gore Creek.
In summer, a tree-lined path along Gore Creek leads to Vail and Lionshead Villages for walking or biking.
Vail and Lionshead Villages are about 1 mile, a 5-minute drive, from the resort.
The outdoor pool is a saline pool with lounge chairs and rental cabanas.
The spa uses products from Hydrafacial, HydroPeptide and Comfort Zone, plus local products such as Phia and Lost Range.
The signature Alpine Transformation Wrap combines a body peel, a mud and micro-algae wrap and a full body massage.
The fitness center is open 24 hours and overlooks the outdoor infinity pool along Gore Creek.
Some rooms and suites are designed for families, with bunk beds.
Family amenities include an arcade and movie nights in the Grand Theater.
Venture Sports, on the first floor, offers ski concierge, valet, overnight tuning and premium ski and snowboard rentals.
Makoto Vail serves contemporary Japanese cuisine from Chef Makoto Okuwa, including sushi, sashimi, Wagyu beef and Japanese spirits and sake.
Gessner Colorado Mountain Grill, named after the Swiss natural historian, blends Rocky Mountain flavors with the European influence of Vail Valley.

highlights.text: The hotel has ski-in/ski-out access to Vail Mountain from Chair 20, steps from its doors.
A heated creek-side infinity pool with two hot tubs, plus cold plunges and saunas on the pool deck.
Many rooms and suites have private balconies overlooking Gore Creek and the western slopes of Vail Mountain, paired with fireplaces.
The Blue Sky Presidential Two-Bedroom Suite has a double-sided fireplace, a dining area for eight, private balconies and a copper soaking tub.
The Vail Residences at Cascade Village range from one-bedroom condominiums to nine-bedroom homes, with full use of the resort amenities.

considerations.text: Chair 20 is open on select dates during the winter season; confirm early or late season operation with the hotel.
The resort is about 1 mile from Vail and Lionshead Villages rather than in them; the nearest airport, Eagle County Regional, is 34 miles away.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing during peak ski season.
